game.title: Chhukpa (Water Game)
game.description: A traditional water game where children and adults compete in swimming, diving, and water-based challenges in Bhutan's pristine rivers and streams.
howToPlay: Step 1: Children gather at a safe swimming spot in a river.
Step 2: They compete in swimming races across or downstream.
Step 3: Diving competitions test who can retrieve stones from the bottom.
Step 4: Underwater swimming distance challenges test breath control.
Step 5: Water tag involves chasing and tagging in shallow areas.
Step 6: Older children teach swimming to younger ones.
Step 7: The game builds water confidence and swimming skills.
Step 8: Safety is emphasized with supervision from experienced swimmers.
Step 9: Winners gain respect among peers.
Step 10: The game connects children to Bhutan's natural water resources.
